Reproducibility: not applicable. this is a new feature PR, not a bug report. Current main lacks the sticker command/RPC surface, and the PR body provides after-change live bridge proof rather than a current-main failure reproduction.

target.title: feat: add sticker sends
target.body:
## Summary
- add `imsg sticker --chat ... --file ... [--attach-to ...]` for bridge-backed sticker sends
- expose `attachments.sendSticker` and `sticker.send` over JSON-RPC
- wire helper-side `send-sticker` handling with native sticker association, sticker metadata, and optional message attachment
- keep release-owned changelog changes out of the branch

## Redacted runtime proof on lobster
Proof collected on lobster with branch-local artifacts from `feat/stickers` and a freshly relaunched SIP-disabled injected Messages.app session. Raw logs stay local because they include chat GUIDs, message GUIDs, transfer GUIDs, and local identifiers.

- branch head: `f199379`
- native manual sticker-reply fixture: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-09/164-stickers/manual-reply-20260709-073038`
- branch final proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-09/164-stickers/fresh-anchor-final-20260709-074248`
- before on `main`: `imsg completions llm` and `imsg status --json` do not expose sticker send surfaces (`sticker.send` / `attachments.sendSticker` absent)
- after on branch: `imsg status --json` reported SIP disabled, bridge v2 ready, `selectors.stickerTransfer=true`, and RPC methods `attachments.sendSticker` plus `sticker.send`
- manual native comparison: a user-created sticker reply produced `associated_message_guid=p:0/<anchor>`, `associated_message_type=1000`, `reply_to_guid=<anchor>`, `cache_has_attachments=1`, `message_summary_info={eogcd:3, ust:true}`, and an outgoing attachment with `is_sticker=1`, sticker user-info, attribution info, transfer state `5`, preview generation state `1`
- branch probe: `imsg sticker --chat <redacted-chat> --file <redacted-sticker-fixture> --attach-to <fresh-anchor-guid> --json` returned a fresh message GUID and transfer GUID
- branch DB readback: the generated row matched the native shape: `associated_message_guid=p:0/<fresh-anchor>`, `associated_message_type=1000`, `reply_to_guid=<fresh-anchor>`, `cache_has_attachments=1`, `is_sent=1`, `error=0`, `message_summary_info` length `63`
- branch attachment readback: the generated attachment had `is_sticker=1`, `mime_type=image/png`, `uti=public.png`, sticker user-info, attribution info, transfer state `5`, preview generation state `1`

## Verification
- `make build` ✅ on lobster for `f199379`
- `swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests TestsLinux` ✅
- `git diff --check` ✅
- `make lint` ⚠️ blocked after swift-format by local SwiftLint/SourceKit crash: `Loading sourcekitdInProc.framework/Versions/A/sourcekitdInProc failed`
- `make test` ⚠️ blocked before project tests run on this host: `Tests/IMsgCoreTests/BridgeHelperLocatorTests.swift:2:8: error: no such module 'Testing'`
